newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds mostly lower on dull market.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds mostly lower on dull market.

text.p: Most sectors of the UK meals and feeds market were lower on Tuesday, but buyers were still staying away.
"Everybody is telling the same story, nothing doing," said one broker.
"You begin to wonder how people are paying their overheads with current state of the market," said another.
Ex-mill high protein soymeal was offers one to four stg down with store down a similar amount.
Rapemeal ex-mill Erith was unchanged while material from the Hull and Liverpool mills was three stg up.
Corn gluten feed pellets, sunflowermeal and sunflower pellets were all unchanged.
